title: Reset scan to the left boundary
statement: Let $W$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $a\in\mathbb{N}$, and fix a schedule-alphabet input $x$, a base configuration, integer controller-head positions, and controller tapes. For any $j\in\mathbb{N}$ with $j\le |x|$, starting in reset-scan phase with input head at position $j$, after exactly $j$ steps the input head is at position $0$ and the configuration is otherwise unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $W$ is a finite Turing machine over Booleans
initial phase is reset-scan and input head is at $j$
replaced:
Suppose the oblivious schedule machine is in a setup configuration in the reset-scan
phase with input head at an interior position $j \le |x|$; the controller tapes and
heads are arbitrary.  Then after exactly $j$ steps the machine is in the same setup
configuration except that the input head is at the left boundary (position $0$): the
phase, all tapes, and all work heads are unchanged.
